command: set -euo pipefail; echo AUDIT_TOP_CPP; find main src lib components -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.cc' -o -name '*.c' -o -name '*.hpp' -o -name '*.h' \) 2>/dev/null | xargs wc -l | sort -nr | head -30; echo AUDIT_TEST_HINTS; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'CMakeLists.txt' -o -name 'pytest.ini' -o -name 'platformio.ini' -o -path '*/.github/workflows/*' \) -print | sort; echo AUDIT_SCRIPTS; find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort | sed -n '1,160p'
